mode: synthetic isolated IPC fixture; no server writes, account credentials or phone actions
checks: guest performs no account reads; login loads categories and official agreement status
trade identities and price selectors mirror the recovered phone options; title uses UTF16 max50
official agreement is sanitized, explicit, cancellable before write and enforces 10.5 seconds before accepting
create uploads the chosen image once, freezes inputs and delivers only the confirmed saved feed
native product search is independent of publishing, Escape returns to the editor, and manual config uses choices
preset picker sends a server configuration ID and category104 suppresses config inputs
unconfirmed creation requires an explicit latest-feed check, preserves its immutable intent and never auto-replays
edit hydrates current server values and sends only the fields changed by the user
failed initial read shows retry without submitting; an unconfirmed edit reloads current server data without replay
account switches reject late editor hydration and late publishing callbacks
close requires permanent-warning confirmation; busy operations block cancel and Escape
unknown close result is recovered only with the independent read-only state operation
verification keeps the original close target; switching account during verification cannot retry the old close
one-key protection leaves read/edit controls usable but prevents a new publication or a late success callback
closed edits display their permanent status and the dark narrow layout stays within the viewport
